players.product: High-purity sputtering targets, evaporation materials and PVD consumables (backing plates, crucible liners) for leading-edge logic, memory (incl. HBM) and data storage

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: defense incoming orders were $90 million in the first half, with more than $500 million of open RFQs (around $300 million last quarter); space orders doubled year-over-year and the space business has grown six times in the last three to four years, perhaps around 25% of aerospace and defense in the quarter; a new $15 million program was secured to deliver advanced materials critical to engine performance for a major commercial space customer, a program he said will probably run about a year to a year and a half. CFO: Performance Materials value-added sales $190 million (+13%); Precision Optics value-added sales $30.8 million (+26%).
quarterly_data.figure: $90 million orders; $500 million RFQs; $15 million program
